shortDescription: An AI-powered planner that creates smart study routines.
detailedDescription: This platform helps students organize study schedules using AI-generated plans based on exams, deadlines, and learning pace.
problemStatement: Students struggle with time management and study consistency.
proposedSolution: Use AI to automatically create personalized study routines and reminders.

shortDescription: Track daily health habits with predictive insights.
detailedDescription: Users can monitor sleep, hydration, exercise, and receive health recommendations using machine learning.
problemStatement: People often fail to maintain healthy routines consistently.
proposedSolution: Provide personalized health tracking with actionable insights and reminders.

shortDescription: A collaboration platform built for remote startup teams.
detailedDescription: This app combines tasks, brainstorming, file sharing, and async communication into one productivity workspace.
problemStatement: Remote teams use too many disconnected tools.
proposedSolution: Centralize communication and workflow in one collaborative workspace.

shortDescription: A green logistics platform using electric vehicles.
detailedDescription: Businesses can use eco-friendly delivery systems powered by EV bikes and route optimization AI.
proposedSolution: Use electric delivery vehicles and optimized routes to reduce emissions.

shortDescription: Practice job interviews with an AI interviewer.
detailedDescription: The platform simulates technical and HR interviews while giving feedback on communication and confidence.
problemStatement: Many candidates lack interview preparation experience.
proposedSolution: Provide realistic AI-based interview simulations with detailed feedback.

shortDescription: Generate viral content ideas for creators instantly.
detailedDescription: Creators can generate YouTube, TikTok, and Instagram content ideas based on trends and audience interests.
problemStatement: Creators often struggle with creative burnout.
proposedSolution: Use AI trend analysis to generate engaging content ideas automatically.

shortDescription: Daily mental wellness support through guided activities.
detailedDescription: The app provides mood tracking, breathing exercises, journaling, and AI wellness suggestions.
problemStatement: Stress and anxiety are increasing among young professionals.
proposedSolution: Offer accessible mental wellness tools and daily emotional support.

shortDescription: Smart budgeting app for personal finance management.
detailedDescription: Users can manage expenses, track savings goals, and receive AI budgeting advice.
problemStatement: People struggle to manage spending and savings effectively.
proposedSolution: Provide automated expense tracking and personalized savings strategies.

shortDescription: Exchange skills instead of paying money.
detailedDescription: Users can trade services like coding, design, language teaching, and marketing through a barter-based system.
problemStatement: Many talented people cannot afford premium learning resources.
proposedSolution: Allow users to exchange skills and services without direct payment.

shortDescription: IoT-based crop monitoring for modern farming.
detailedDescription: Farmers can monitor soil quality, irrigation, and crop health using sensors and analytics.
problemStatement: Farmers often lack real-time insights about crop conditions.
proposedSolution: Use IoT sensors and analytics to improve farming efficiency and crop yield.
